review_notes: The current Customs Authority guidance says tourists must obtain an appropriate visa and that, in most cases, a visa may be obtained on arrival. It expressly states that nationals of countries other than Indonesia, Portugal and the United States may apply for a visa on arrival only at Dili International Airport or Dili Sea Port. Bangladesh ordinary-passport holders fall within this 'other countries' group; no BGD-specific exclusion was identified. USD30 is payable in cash. Passport must be valid at least six months and have one whole unused page; traveler must complete an arrival card and may be asked to show genuine visit purpose, sufficient funds and accommodation. A return/onward ticket or proof of ability to fund departure is required. Land-border arrivals require prior Visa Application Authorization. The official English and Portuguese Customs pages agree. The public guidance does not state a standard permitted stay, entry count, fixed processing time, travel-insurance requirement or BGD-specific health rule.
